summary.goal: Build the Interviewer as a persistent RelayClient service that facilitates brainstorming conversations. The Interviewer is a pure facilitator - it never reveals specialists to the user, spawns them lazily as needed, and weaves their insights into the conversation naturally.

acceptance_criteria.description: Interviewer runs as persistent service (not spawn), using RelayClient
Interviewer listens on #ideation channel and #ideation-{session_id} channels
Interviewer uses Anthropic API for LLM responses (with mock mode fallback)
Interviewer maintains conversation history per session
Interviewer has tools: start_session, add_message, read_session, update_understanding, send_to_planner, spawn_specialist
Interviewer spawns specialists LAZILY - on-demand when conversation needs specific expertise
Interviewer NEVER reveals specialists to user - it's a pure 1:1 facilitated conversation
Interviewer receives questions/observations from specialists via Relay and weaves them into its own questions naturally
Interviewer facilitates without dominating (asks clarifying questions, draws out requirements)
System prompt defines facilitator personality and lazy spawning strategy
Mock mode provides canned responses when ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is missing

decisions.rationale: Spawn specialists on-demand based on conversation needs, not all at start. More efficient, allows dynamic specialist types.
User sees only the Interviewer. Specialists are invisible infrastructure. Questions/insights are presented as Interviewer's own.
Not limited to 5 predefined roles. Interviewer decides what expertise is needed and spawns appropriate specialist.

steps.title: Create Interviewer config and constants
steps.description: Define Interviewer configuration matching PlannerLead pattern

acceptance_criteria.description: INTERVIEWER_CONFIG = { name: 'Interviewer', displayName: 'Brainstorming Facilitator', role: 'interviewer' }
IDEATION_CHANNEL = '#ideation'
sessionChannelId(sessionId) = `#ideation-${sessionId.slice(0,8)}`

steps.title: Create Interviewer system prompt
steps.description: Define the facilitator personality and behavior guidelines

acceptance_criteria.description: Prompt emphasizes: facilitation over direction, clarifying questions, drawing out requirements
Prompt includes context about available specialists and when to surface their insights
Prompt instructs: don't dominate, let human lead, ask 'what else?'
getInterviewerPrompt({ sessionId, channelId }) returns contextual system prompt

steps.title: Define Interviewer tools
steps.description: Create Anthropic tool definitions for Interviewer capabilities (lazy spawning)

acceptance_criteria.description: start_session: { initial_intent: string } -> creates session, returns session_id (NO auto-spawn)
read_session: { session_id: string } -> returns session with transcript and understanding
add_message: { session_id, role, content } -> appends message to transcript
update_understanding: { session_id, specialist_name: string, observations: Record<string, unknown> } -> updates specialist observations (freeform)
send_to_planner: { session_id, goal?, context? } -> creates/updates plan from session understanding
spawn_specialist: { session_id, name: string, focus: string, prompt_context?: string } -> spawns single specialist on-demand

steps.title: Implement tool execution
steps.description: Create executeTool function that calls storage/API

acceptance_criteria.description: executeTool(name, input, storage) dispatches to correct handler
Returns ToolResult = { success: boolean, data?: unknown, error?: string }
getMockToolResult(name, input) returns canned responses for mock mode

steps.title: Create lazy specialist spawning logic
steps.description: Implement on-demand specialist spawning (not all at once)

acceptance_criteria.description: spawnSpecialist(sessionId, name, focus, promptContext?) spawns single specialist on-demand
Specialist name can be any string (not limited to fixed roles)
Focus describes what expertise this specialist provides
Specialist is spawned via Relay spawn() with session context and focus
Specialist joins the session channel automatically
Returns ActiveSpecialist { name, agent_id, spawned_at, role_hint }
Session.active_specialists[] is updated with new specialist

steps.title: Implement conversation history
steps.description: Track conversation history per session channel

acceptance_criteria.description: addMessage(channelId, role, content) adds to history
getHistory(channelId) returns ConversationMessage[]
History is in-memory (persisted via session transcript in DB)

steps.title: Implement specialist input queue
steps.description: Queue specialist questions/observations for Interviewer to weave into conversation

acceptance_criteria.description: SpecialistInput = { specialist_name: string, type: 'question' | 'observation' | 'concern', content: string, priority: number }
queueSpecialistInput(sessionId, input) adds to queue
getNextInput(sessionId) returns highest priority input
Interviewer weaves specialist input into its own questions (never attributes to specialist)

steps.title: Create Interviewer service
steps.description: Main service file with init/stop lifecycle

acceptance_criteria.description: initInterviewer(storage) registers message handler via onMessage()
stopInterviewer() unsubscribes and cleans up
isInterviewerActive() returns boolean
Service emits agent status events (joined, working, idle)

steps.title: Implement message handling
steps.description: Handle incoming messages and generate responses

acceptance_criteria.description: shouldHandleMessage() filters for #ideation and #ideation-* channels
handleMessage() checks specialist queue, generates response with tools
Messages from specialists are parsed and queued, not responded to directly
Response sent via sendChannelMessage()

steps.title: Implement LLM response generation
steps.description: Generate responses using Anthropic API with tool loop

acceptance_criteria.description: generateResponse(channelId, message, sessionId) calls Anthropic API
Handles tool_use responses in loop until text response
Falls back to generateMockResponse() when no API key
Updates agent status to 'working' during generation

steps.title: Implement session announcement
steps.description: Announce Interviewer when new session channel becomes active

acceptance_criteria.description: notifyNewSession(sessionId, initialIntent) sends welcome message
Welcome introduces Interviewer and explains process
Asks first clarifying question based on intent

steps.description: Unit and integration tests for Interviewer service

acceptance_criteria.description: Test tool execution
Test message filtering
Test specialist input queue
Test mock mode responses
